newsitem.title: EU: EP INSTITUTIONAL COMMITTEE AGENDA - MAY 20-21.
newsitem.headline: EP INSTITUTIONAL COMMITTEE AGENDA - MAY 20-21.

text.p: Committee on Institutional Affairs [[ Tuesday 20 May 1997 ]] 0.1 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 10 March 1997 (PE222.231 ) - 17 and 18 March 1997 (PE222.230 ) 3. Chairman's announcements ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 4. Relations between the European Parliament and the national parliaments (T04634) INI0485 INI0485 + INST Fond R NEYTS-UYTTEBROECK An (ELD) (PE221.698/A ) - Vote on and adoption of draft report 5. Consideration of a motion for a resolution on the draft Treaty ([2] ) - Deadline for tabling amendments 6. Exchange of views with Mr DINI, Italian Foreign Minister, on the Intergovernmental Conference ([3] ) 7. Exchange of views with Mr Bonde (IGC monitor) on openness, transparency, simplification and codification ([4] ) 8.1 Members monitoring the Intergovernmental Conference - 1. Citizenship, fundamental rights, uniform electoral procedure: AGLIETTA/Green Party (PE218.748 ) - 2. Social dimension, employment and the environmental dimension: BARROS MOURA/PSE (PE221.696+ANN) - 4. Third pillar: CEDERSCHIOLD/PPE (PE221.699/958) - 5. Institutions, subsidiarity, flexibility: DELL'ALBA/ARE (PE222.228 ) 8.2 Members monitoring the Intergovernmental Conference (continued) - 6. Finance, budget, fraud: MARRA/UPE (PE219.961 ) - 7. Majority voting, unanimity, weighting of votes and legislative procedures: SCHWAIGER/PPE (PE221.688+ANN) - 8. CFSP: SPAAK/ELDR (PE221.697 ) - 9. Role of the Committee of the Regions and economic cohesion: GUTIERREZ DIAZ/GUE 9. Any other business 10. Date of next meeting (Brussels) (PE/XVI/OJ/97-13 )

[FOOTNOTES]1. ) A coordinators' meeting will be held at the end of the meeting. 2. ) To be confirmed, subject to the date on which the draft Treaty is forwarded. 3. ) Wednesday 21 May at 9.30 a.m. 4. ) Tuesday 20 May at 4 p.m. - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
